label: H.R. 131
title: Finish the Arkansas Valley Conduit Act

items.snippet: This bill reduces payments that communities within the Arkansas River Valley must pay to the Bureau of Reclamation for the construction of the Arkansas Valley Conduit, a pipeline in Colorado for delivering water from the Pueblo Reservoir to such communities.
